intro: Missouri brings luxury into motion. With genuine leather where it matters, dual comfort zones, and touch-controlled recline with USB port, it’s a home upgrade that feels like first class.

features.title: Recline how you feel
features.text: Our dual motors let you independently adjust the back up to 134 degrees as well as the footrest—because comfort isn’t one-size-fits-all.

features.title: We soften your day, your way
features.text: With soft foam and genuine leather touchpoints, every lean, pause, and lie-back feels supported and soothing.

features.title: We extend comfort to your feet
features.text: With an integrated footrest and cushioned head support, our recliner sofa lets you stretch out fully—relieving pressure from head to toe with every recline.

features.title: A chaise that invites you to stay
features.text: Positioned at one end, the extended chaise offers generous legroom—perfect for lounging, reading, or napping in effortless comfort.

features.title: Power at your fingertips
features.text: The built-in USB port keeps your devices charged while you unwind—so you never have to leave your seat when you’re in your zone.

features.title: Back support that holds you fully
features.text: The high backrest is designed to cradle your entire upper body, offering deep lumbar support that helps you truly let go and relax.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Missouri L Shape Leather Motorised Recliner Sofa
